  • Method Details

    • automationUsesSharedIdentity

      public static void automationUsesSharedIdentity(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Every loader attributes automation to the same [SomeStacks] profile. To reproduce in-game: configure a claim or logging mod to report the actor for machine-driven stack growth or cleanup. It reports [SomeStacks] with the shared profile identity.

    • checkedPlacementPlacesInBoundsAndRejectsOutsideBuildHeight

      public static void checkedPlacementPlacesInBoundsAndRejectsOutsideBuildHeight(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Checked world edits place inside build height and reject positions outside it. To reproduce in-game: grow or place a stack in ordinary space, then attempt the same edit at the world's vertical limit. Only the in-bounds placement succeeds.

    • checkedPlacementRejectsAnObstructingEntity

      public static void checkedPlacementRejectsAnObstructingEntity(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Stack placement refuses a living entity intersecting its final collision shape. To reproduce in-game: stand or put a mob in the occupied part of a proposed stack and try to place or grow it. No stack block appears.

    • creativeDepositFillsTheStackWithoutSpendingTheHand

      public static void creativeDepositFillsTheStackWithoutSpendingTheHand(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Creative deposits fill a stack without consuming the held items. To reproduce in-game: switch to Creative, hold the modifier, and deposit a full held stack into Storage. Storage receives the items while the hand retains its original count.

    • placementIntoWaterKeepsTheWater

      public static void placementIntoWaterKeepsTheWater(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Placing a stack into water waterlogs it instead of removing the fluid. To reproduce in-game: hold the modifier and place a new stack into a water source. The block appears waterlogged and the water remains present.

    • checkAdjacentAndDirectDeposits

      public static void checkAdjacentAndDirectDeposits(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory, boolean neighborAllowed)
      Exercises neighboring and direct deposits under the loader's destination policy.

    • playerBarExtractionUsesPlayerForCleanup

      public static void playerBarExtractionUsesPlayerForCleanup(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory, ProtectionChecks.RemovalObserver observer)
      To reproduce in-game: allow a player but deny [SomeStacks] in a claim, then extract the last Bar. Cleanup carries the player and removes the empty block.

    • mixedStorageSettlementUsesAutomationForCleanup

      public static void mixedStorageSettlementUsesAutomationForCleanup(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory, ProtectionChecks.RemovalObserver observer)
      To reproduce in-game: allow a player but deny [SomeStacks], extract one of two Storage items by hand and the other by automation before settlement. Mixed cleanup uses [SomeStacks], so the empty block remains until removal is allowed.

    • vetoedPlacementRestoresBlockEntity

      public static void vetoedPlacementRestoresBlockEntity(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory, Runnable installVeto, Runnable removeVeto)
      To reproduce in-game: deny stack placement over a modded replaceable container containing items. The refused placement restores the container's contents. This stages the rollback directly with a chest so no test-only replaceable block registration is needed.

    • placementPublicationAnswersToVeto

      public static void placementPublicationAnswersToVeto(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory, Runnable installVeto, Runnable removeVeto)
      To reproduce in-game: face an observer toward a denied placement position. A rejected placement produces no observer pulse; after permitting the same placement, the observer pulses.
